install: claude mcp add --scope project --transport http --client-id YOUR_CLIENT_ID --client-secret --callback-port 8080 asana https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp
verify: Start claude, run /mcp to confirm the asana server is connected, then ask for the tasks of one project (read only).
read_only_mitigation: The documentation read does not describe a read-only mode: connect with a user who has read-only (viewer) access to the needed projects, and allow only read tools by exact name after reviewing the tool list.
